item.title: Council Questions $65K Defense for Officers in Washington Case
item.description: Jersey City councilmembers debate hiring outside lawyers for officers sued over the 2023 fatal shooting of Andrew Washington during a mental health crisis.

item.title: 3 Rescued, 5 Hurt In 3-Alarm Jersey City Fire
item.description: Firefighters rescued 3 people, a cat, and a dog from a 3-alarm fire at 154 Summit Ave. in Jersey City. Five were injured, and 11 residents were displaced.

item.title: Jersey City ER at Heights University Hospital Closing March 14
item.description: Heights University Hospital in Jersey City will close its emergency room March 14, ending all services after financial losses, funding disputes, and opposition.

item.title: Solomon Vows Fight After Heights University Hospital Closure
item.description: Mayor James Solomon said, “we will keep fighting” after Heights University Hospital closed March 14, leaving Jersey City with one ER.

item.title: Hudson County Ends HCST Tuition Fee Plan for 2026–2027
item.description: Hudson County officials say the HCST plan to charge municipal tuition for the 2026–2027 school year will not proceed as leaders review an $11M deficit.

item.title: NJCU Player Stranded in Jordan Gets Flight Home
item.description: After nearly two weeks stranded in Jordan, NJCU basketball player Eugene Campbell III has received a plane ticket home and is scheduled to depart on Friday.

item.title: The Roost Outpost Hoboken Closing After 10 Years
item.description: The Roost Outpost Coffee Co. in Hoboken will close March 22, 2026, after failed lease negotiations at 55 1st Street. The café served the community for 10 years.
